review_note: Checked on 27 September 2026 against AlphaTheta, Pioneer DJ, Denon DJ, Engine DJ and Mixxx documentation and against reports on the Pioneer DJ and Engine DJ community forums. Every vendor or community claim cites its sources below; claims no document covers are marked 'inferred'. MBR support is taken from the documents that confirm FAT32, since they describe MBR-partitioned sticks and name the GUID partition map as the exception. Nothing here is lab verified yet.
claim_syntax: Each claim is '<support>/<evidence>'. support: supported | unsupported | unreliable | unknown. evidence: vendor | lab | community | inferred | unknown.

at-cdj1500x-fs.title: AlphaTheta Help Center: The CDJ-1500X doesn't recognize some USB storage devices
at-cdj1500x-fs.note: FAT16, FAT32, exFAT and HFS+. NTFS isn't supported.

at-cdj2000-format.title: AlphaTheta Help Center: Recommended format for USB devices on the CDJ-2000
at-cdj2000-format.note: FAT, FAT32 and HFS+ only. HFS, case-sensitive Mac OS Extended and the GUID partition map aren't supported.

at-exfat-list.note: Players that read exFAT, with minimum firmware: CDJ-3000 1.20, XDJ-XZ 1.23, XDJ-RX3 1.11. Players not listed don't read exFAT.

at-omnis-formats.title: AlphaTheta Help Center: Which file formats can I play? (OMNIS-DUO)
at-omnis-formats.note: MP3, AAC, WAV, AIFF, ALAC and FLAC; lossless up to 96 kHz/24-bit.

at-omnis-fs.title: AlphaTheta Help Center: The unit doesn't recognize some USB storage devices and HDDs (OMNIS-DUO)

at-opus-formats.note: MP3, AAC, WAV, AIFF, ALAC and FLAC; 44.1 and 48 kHz only, 88.2 and 96 kHz aren't supported.

at-usb-notice-2026.note: CDJ-3000X, OPUS-QUAD, OMNIS-DUO and XDJ-AZ read OneLibrary. CDJ-3000, XDJ-XZ and older units read Device Library. rekordbox 7.2.11 and later write both on export.

at-usb-power.title: AlphaTheta Help Center: Can power be supplied from the USB port when a portable hard disk is connected?

at-virtualdj-onelibrary.title: AlphaTheta: VirtualDJ officially supports OneLibrary

at-xdj1000mk2-fw-guide.title: AlphaTheta Help Center: XDJ-1000MK2 firmware update guide

at-xdjaz-formats.title: AlphaTheta Help Center: Which file formats can I play on the XDJ-AZ?

at-xdjxz-fs.title: AlphaTheta Help Center: The unit doesn't recognize some USB storage devices (XDJ-XZ)

c-cdj-2tb.title: Pioneer DJ forums: Is it possible to use a 4 TB external hard drive with CDJ-2000 Nexus?
c-cdj-2tb.note: CDJs don't read GUID partition tables, so drives stop at the MBR limit of 2 TB.

c-cdj3000-exfat.title: Pioneer DJ forums: CDJ 3000 USB settings / Mac / exFAT / problems live performing
c-cdj3000-exfat.note: exFAT sticks intermittently showing FORMAT USB on CDJ-3000s.

c-engine-gpt.title: Engine DJ Community: Internal SSD size limit 2 TB (MBR) or can I use GPT?
c-engine-gpt.note: A 4 TB GPT + exFAT internal SSD reported working in a PRIME 4.

c-engine-hfs.title: Engine DJ Community: HFS+ on Prime 4
c-engine-hfs.note: HFS+ arrived with Engine OS 2.4 on the PRIME 4+ and SC6000; the original PRIME 4 doesn't read it.

c-engine-ntfs.title: Engine DJ Community: Does Engine 1.5.1 not support NTFS drives anymore?
c-engine-ntfs.note: NTFS drives rejected as an unsupported format since Engine OS 1.5.1.

c-engine-onelibrary.title: Engine DJ Community: OneLibrary
c-engine-onelibrary.note: Users asking for OneLibrary; Engine DJ doesn't read it.

c-nxs2-gpt.title: Pioneer DJ Community: CDJ-2000nxs2 'Format Disk' error on FAT32 exported USB [FIX]
c-nxs2-gpt.note: Mac-formatted FAT32 sticks with a GUID partition map rejected on firmware 1.87 (2024); MBR fixed it. Mac-only DJs recommend HFS+ on the NXS2.

dn-prime4-faq.title: Denon DJ: PRIME 4 frequently asked questions
dn-prime4-faq.note: Storage must be FAT32 or exFAT with an MBR partition structure; exFAT recommended from 1 TB.

dn-prime4plus-faq.title: Denon DJ: PRIME 4+ frequently asked questions
dn-prime4plus-faq.note: Storage must be FAT32 or exFAT with an MBR partition structure; exFAT recommended from 1 TB.

dn-sc5000-guide.title: Denon DJ: SC5000 PRIME user guide v1.9
dn-sc5000-guide.note: Compressed and uncompressed formats including AIFF, FLAC, ALAC and WAV.

dn-sc6000-guide.title: Denon DJ: SC6000 PRIME user guide v1.6
dn-sc6000-guide.note: AAC/M4A, AIFF, ALAC, FLAC, MP3, MP4, Ogg Vorbis and WAV; WAV and AIFF at 44.1 to 192 kHz, 16 to 32 bits.

en-formatting.title: Engine DJ: Formatting a hard drive for DJ performance
en-formatting.note: Drives for Engine OS hardware must be FAT32 or exFAT; exFAT recommended from 1 TB.

en-user-guide.title: Engine DJ user guide v4.5.0
en-user-guide.note: Engine OS hardware plays drives exported from Engine DJ (Engine Library/Database2).

mx-manual-library.title: Mixxx user manual: The Mixxx Library
mx-manual-library.note: Browses folders on connected drives; plays WAV, AIFF, MP3, Ogg Vorbis, FLAC, Opus and AAC where the OS provides it.

mx-onelibrary-issue.title: Mixxx issue #15556: Add OneLibrary support
mx-onelibrary-issue.note: Open; Mixxx doesn't read OneLibrary yet.

mx-rekordbox.title: Mixxx: New in 2.3, importing tracks and cues from Rekordbox removable devices
mx-rekordbox.note: Reads playlists, beatgrids, hot cues, memory cues and loops from rekordbox USB exports.

pdj-cdj3000-fw330.title: Pioneer DJ: CDJ-3000 firmware ver. 3.30 important notice
pdj-cdj3000-fw330.note: 3.30 (October 2025) added OneLibrary and was withdrawn. 3.22 (January 2026) reads Device Library only.

pdj-nxs2.title: Pioneer DJ: CDJ-2000NXS2 product page
pdj-nxs2.note: MP3, AAC, WAV, AIFF, FLAC and ALAC; lossless up to 96 kHz/24-bit.

pdj-xdj1000mk2-specs.title: Pioneer DJ: XDJ-1000MK2 specifications
pdj-xdj1000mk2-specs.note: MP3, AAC, WAV, AIFF, FLAC and ALAC up to 48 kHz/24-bit.

press-cdj1500x.title: DJ TechTools: The CDJ-1500X is AlphaTheta's first budget-minded media player since the XDJ-1000MK2
press-cdj1500x.note: Reads OneLibrary only, no Device Library.

press-cdj3000-fw330.title: MusicTech: CDJ-3000 firmware bug, what really happened
press-cdj3000-fw330.note: Playlists weren't deleted: 3.30 read an outdated OneLibrary database sitting next to a current Device Library.
